indicator.definition: Number of occupied housing units whose structure is "Attached house, 20 or more floors", as recorded by the Census of Population and Housing 2024. Each housing unit is counted in exactly one category. Published by DCS for DS divisions and districts only; there is no GN breakdown. DCS's English heading reads "Attached House - From 20th Floors or more"; the Sinhala and Tamil headings give the number of floors of the building, which is how this name reads it (not confirmed by DCS).
